questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned}\cos(xe^x) & = 1-\frac{1}{2!}(xe^x)^2+\frac{1}{4!}(xe^x)^4+o\left((xe^x)^5\right) = 1-\frac{1}{2}x^2e^{2x}+\frac{1}{24}x^4e^{4x}+o\left(x^5\right)\\= & 1-\frac{1}{2}x^2\left(1+2x+\frac{1}{2!}(2x)^2+\frac{1}{3!}(2x)^3+o(x^3)\right)+\frac{1}{24}x^4\left(1+4x+o(x^2)\right)+o\left(x^5\right)\\= & 1-\frac{1}{2}x^2-x^3-\frac{23}{24}x^4-\frac{1}{2}x^5+o\left(x^5\right),\\\cos(xe^x) & = \cos(-xe^x) = 1-\frac{1}{2}(-x)^2-(-x)^3-\frac{23}{24}(-x)^4-\frac{1}{2}(-x)^5+o\left(x^5\right)\\= & 1-\frac{1}{2}x^2+x^3-\frac{23}{24}x^4+\frac{1}{2}x^5+o\left(x^5\right),\\\lim_{x\rightarrow 0}\frac{\cos(xe^x)-\cos(xe^{-x})+2x^3}{(1-\cos x)\ln^3(1+x)}\\= & 2\lim_{x\rightarrow 0}\frac{\cos(xe^x)-\cos(xe^{-x})+2x^3}{x^5}=2\lim_{x\rightarrow 0}\frac{-x^5+o(x^5)}{x^5}=-2\,.\end{aligned}

questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned}&\lim_{x\rightarrow +\infty}\left(\xi\sqrt{x^6+x^5}-\xi\sqrt{x^6-x^5}\right)=\lim_{x\rightarrow +\infty}x\left(\left(1+\frac{1}{x}\right)^{\frac{1}{6}}-\left(1-\frac{1}{x}\right)^{\frac{1}{6}}\right)\\&=\lim_{x\rightarrow +\infty}x\left(\left(1+\frac{1}{6x}+o\left(\frac{1}{x}\right)\right)-\left(1-\frac{1}{6x}+o\left(\frac{1}{x}\right)\right)\right)\\&=\lim_{x\rightarrow +\infty}\left(\frac{1}{3}+o\left(1\right)\right)=\frac{1}{3}.\end{aligned}

questions.prompt_html: \text{极限} \lim_{x \rightarrow 0} \frac{ \cos(xe^{x}) - \cos(xe^{-x}) + 2x^{3}}{ \ln^{5}{(1+x)}} = \ \ [ \ \ \ \ \ ] .
questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned}&\cos(xe^x)=1-\frac{1}{2}(xe^x)^2+\frac{1}{4!}(xe^x)^4+o\left((xe^x)^5\right)=1-\frac{1}{2}x^2e^{2x}+\frac{1}{24}x^4e^{4x}+o\left(x^5\right)\\&=1-\frac{1}{2}x^2\left(1+2x+\frac{1}{2!}(2x)^2+\frac{1}{3!}(2x)^3+o(x^3)\right)+\frac{1}{24}x^4\left(1+4x+o(x^2)\right)+o\left(x^5\right)\\&=1-\frac{1}{2}x^2-x^3-\frac{23}{24}x^4-\frac{1}{2}x^5+o\left(x^5\right),\\&\quad\cos(xe^x)=\cos(-xe^x)=1-\frac{1}{2}(-x)^2-(-x)^3-\frac{23}{24}(-x)^4-\frac{1}{2}(-x)^5+o\left(x^5\right)\\&=1-\frac{1}{2}x^2+x^3-\frac{23}{24}x^4+\frac{1}{2}x^5+o\left(x^5\right),\\&\lim_{x\rightarrow 0}\frac{\cos(xe^x)-\cos(xe^{-x})+2x^3}{\ln^5(1+x)}=\lim_{x\rightarrow 0}\frac{\cos(xe^x)-\cos(xe^{-x})+2x^3}{x^5}=\lim_{x\rightarrow 0}\frac{-x^5+o(x^5)}{x^5}=-1.\end{aligned}

questions.prompt_html: \text{极限} \lim_{x \to 0} \frac{e^{x^{2}} - \cos x}{x^{2}} = \ \ [ \ \ \ \ ] .
questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned}&\lim_{x \rightarrow 0} \frac{e^{x^2}-\cos x}{x^2} \\&=\lim_{x \rightarrow 0} \frac{\left(1+x^2+o(x^2)\right)-\left(1-\frac{x^2}{2!}+o(x^2)\right)}{x^4} \\&=\lim_{x \rightarrow 0} \frac{2^{\frac{3}{2}x^2+o(x^2)}}{x^2}=\frac{3}{2}.\end{aligned}
